about: Gates of `gstore-bench check` / `compare` / `ci` (see bench/README.md). Exact gates always apply. Timing gates are one-sided and calibration-normalized: a measured time m is divided by clamp(calib_measured / calib_baseline) and compared with the baseline time b as (m + floor_ms) / (b + floor_ms); the per-backend query geomean uses the raw medians. Memory: (m + floor_mib) / (b + floor_mib). Sizes: m / b. A failing timing or memory gate re-runs only the failing phases, up to `retries` times, keeping the minimum of the medians.
